stem: Which sentence from “A Baseball School for Big-League Dreamers” contrasts with the attitude expressed in the sentence from “I Believe in the Also-Rans”?
instruction: Read this sentence from paragraph 2 of “I Believe in the Also-Rans.”

options.label: F
options.text: “You kind of just don’t want to leave the field at the end of the night,” he says.

options.label: G
options.text: “We are not sending the message that every one of our players are going to wind up playing shortstop for the Mets.”

options.label: H
options.text: Bolek, who has coached in the minors, the majors and college, says his job is not always about baseball.

options.label: J
options.text: And there’s something else: Many of the coaches have given years to the game.

visual_elements: As an English teenager I was schooled in an elite school where I was fed the idea that I was better than others and that achievement and winning were all-important.
